name: Olivia Scarlett
original_name: オリヴィア・スカーレット
source:
A captain who leads one of the three pirate factions whom are active in the waters near the kingdom. She is rumored to have the strongest force of the three pirate factions.
She earned the nickname "Olivia, the female barbarian" because she is a female leader and she hates weak men as she leads a pirate group consisting of mostly females.
Originally from a well-known family who fell to ruin. Perhaps because of this, she has a dignity that does not impair her while she is in the rough pirate business.
